svg.text: n_hidden 512 (registers) · c_context 384 · 8×8 grid · depth 8 · 3 context DFFs in a RESIDUAL CASCADE, LEARNED windows (init 2 / 2 / 2), RMS-normalized reads · reset to 0 at <STX> · one shared linout (semi-orthogonal init) · concatenated read, no text_proj · batch 250 · SGD lr 0.03 · SimpleStories (100%)
next token → fed back as the next step's input (autoregressive)
dashed: old state r (Q) back into each EMA · R: reset to 0 at <STX>
each read through its own 512-channel block of ctx_cat
context DFFs: residual cascade, learned windows, normalized reads
reset to 0 at every <STX>; the first write blends from 0, so each register is a
running average of the current document only (registers detached: 1-step gradient)
DFF_1 ← EMA_W1(x) · DFF_2 ← EMA_W2(x − DFF_1[t]) · DFF_3 ← EMA_W3(x − DFF_2[t])
DFF_k[t] is the value written this step, so the cascade settles within one clock
W_k = exp(θ_k): 3 trainable scalars (init 2 tokens, lr ×100), trained by one-step lookahead:
read at t+1 as r + (a − a.detach())·e, e = innovation of the write at t (exact d loss / d a)
read side: each register scaled to rms 0.015 (per row, over 512×8×8; no parameters)
conv 3×3 unpadded (linear, no BN/ReLU): dec_tree.0, dec_tree.1, decoder.proj
subtractor: x minus the faster register's new value
D flip-flop, clocked once per token step; R = synchronous reset to 0
data / state path (labelled where it matters)
old register value r into its EMA
Per token: ≈803M conv MAC (679M ContextCNN, 57M 1×1s, 54M decoder, 13M lmhead)
